title: Bali-mazer of Tyre’s tribute to Shalmaneser III
summary: Shalmaneser III’s Black Obelisk claims tribute from Ba-’a-li-ma-an-zer of Tyre.
description: Shalmaneser III’s Black Obelisk claims tribute from Ba-’a-li-ma-an-zer of Tyre. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 3 (Table 2 “Harmonized Chronology of Tyre and Carthage”, row ~841, p. 46; Part 2 Table 1, row 841, p. 37).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 3): ~841 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 3: The Founding Dates of Tyre and Carthage," OSF preprint v1.2 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9V65S, Table 2 “Harmonized Chronology of Tyre and Carthage”, row ~841, p. 46; Part 2 Table 1, row 841, p. 37
chronologies.note: Bali-mazer the high priest of Baal Melqart in Tyre paid tribute to Shalmaneser III, “perhaps 2 or 3 decades earlier than the date cited”.
